note: Column grid master for บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 5 -- derived from S-02 (แปลนฐานรากแผ่) and S-03 (แปลนฐานรากเสาเข็ม), cross-confirmed identical between both sheets; dummy grid ground-floor-only extension seen on S-04/S-05. Dummy grid lines added 2026-07-24 (reviewer Makham) from beam-plan pages หน้า32-35 dimension chains -- see per-line source/flags.

x_lines.note: Before origin (grid1=0.0) -> negative pos_m per schema origin rule; named 1' as leftmost of the grid-1 dummy group (1' -0.6 < 1'' 1.5 < 1''' 2.0).

x_lines.source: architecture ground-floor plan A-04 (หน้า06) printed dimension chain
x_lines.note: The 4.00 grid1-grid2 interval is sub-split on A-04 as 1.50 + 0.50 + 2.00, giving lines at x=1.50 and x=2.00. This is the 1.50 one -- the west wall face of the SOA canopy in the F-E band on S-04. NO beam lands on it on any structural sheet: it is a wall/slab-edge line, kept because it is a printed, dimensioned line of the building, not because a beam endpoint needs it.

x_lines.source: architecture ground-floor plan A-04 (หน้า06) printed dimension chain; beam endpoint on S-05
x_lines.note: Second line of the A-04 grid1-grid2 sub-split (1.50 + 0.50 + 2.00). Confirmed structurally: beam B1 D1'''-C1''' on the floor-2 beam plan (S-05) lands exactly here.
Between grid3 (6.0) and grid4 (9.0); left main grid = grid3 -> 3'.
After grid4 (9.0); left main grid = grid4 -> 4'.

y_lines.note: Stair lane-divider beam line in the D-C band. Position given by reviewer as 2 + 3.7 + 1.1 = 6.8 on the F=0 origin axis (F0 -> E2.0 -> D5.7 -> D'6.8). Named D' per the rule (nearest main grid ABOVE is D). Carries beam B1 D'3-D'4.

y_lines.source: reviewer 2026-07-24, corrected against architecture ground-floor plan A-04 (หน้า06) printed dimension chain
y_lines.note: Divider beam line inside the B-A bay. Reviewer first gave this as the B-A midpoint (b-a/2 = 12.5); corrected to 12.2 = B(11.6) + 0.60 because the architecture ground-floor plan sub-splits the 1.80 B-A interval as 0.60 + 0.50 (partial), and the beam itself measures B+0.60 on the tie-beam plan (S-06) and B+0.645 on the floor-2 beam plan (S-05) -- both ~0.60, none near 0.90. Carries beam B2 B'1-B'2 on S-05.

y_lines.source: printed 2.05 dimension south of grid A on A-04 (หน้า06), รูปด้าน 2 (หน้า10), รูปตัด 1 (หน้า13), EE-03 (หน้า61), EE-05 (หน้า63)
y_lines.note: Ground-floor-only envelope edge 2.05 m south of grid A, printed as its own dimension on five independent sheets. RESOLVED via A-04 + the ST.1 detail sheet (หน้า20): this strip is the ทางเดิน / ST.1 entrance-step sequence (+0.20 -> +0.50 -> +0.60), NOT the carport/terrace slab the structural read first guessed. NO beam lands on it -- the two beams previously recorded at A'1-A'2 were removed 2026-07-24 by the reviewer, and on S-04 the line at this offset is drawn as a single slab-edge line, not the paired lines every real beam on that sheet uses. Kept as a dummy grid because it is a real, printed, dimensioned building line; floor 2 does not extend here (S-05 shows only a 0.40 m overhang).

warnings: Footing plan shows an irregular (non-full-rectangular) footprint: no footing at grid1-gridF, grid3-gridA/B/F, or grid3-gridB -- building footprint is not a simple rectangle, consistent with an L-shaped or notched floor plan typical of these house designs.

This house (บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 5, drawing no. S58136) is significantly larger than houses #2-#4 in floor area (224 sqm per house #4's price-reference table read on หน้า93) -- 13.40m x 9.00m overall footprint here vs house #4's smaller grid, consistent with the larger size.
The 0.60m/0.50m dimensions beyond grid1/grid4 seen on both S-04 and S-05's top dimension chains are eave/slab-edge overhangs (no beam drawn beyond those points), not additional dummy grid lines.
2026-07-24 dummy grids added from beam-plan pages หน้า32-35 (reviewer Makham): x-axis 1'(-0.6), 1''(1.5), 1'''(2.0), 3'(6.3), 4'(9.5), y-axis e'(4.4), f'(-1.0) — entered exactly as given by reviewer.

2026-07-24 y-axis re-based: origin moved from grid A (was 0.0) to grid F (now 0.0), reading top-to-bottom as F->A per reviewer. All named y-grid positions updated (E=2.0, D=5.7, C=7.9, B=11.6, A=13.4). This resolves an earlier apparent naming mismatch on e'/f' -- under the OLD A=0 orientation, e'(4.4) and f'(-1.0) looked misnamed (closest to C/A instead of E/F), but under this corrected F=0 orientation both are correctly named (e' sits between F and E, f' sits before origin F, same pattern as an origin-adjacent prime). Legacy 'Aprime' (was -2.05 under old orientation) renamed to 'A'' and re-based to 15.45 under the new orientation -- same physical line, position/id both updated together, not a new grid.

2026-07-24: dummy row ids normalized to uppercase (e'->E', f'->F') to match the project convention used by every other row (F/E/D/C/B/A/A') and by house-04's E'. Same physical lines, positions unchanged (E'=4.4, F'=-1.0). Nothing referenced them before the rename.
2026-07-24: added dummy row D' = 6.8 (reviewer formula 2+3.7+1.1) between D(5.7) and C(7.9) -- the stair lane-divider line; confirmed by beam B1 D'3-D'4 landing on it (beam-endpoint rule).
2026-07-24: added dummy row B' = 12.5 (reviewer: midpoint b-a/2, i.e. (11.6+13.4)/2) between B(11.6) and A(13.4) -- required by beam B2 B'1-B'2 on หน้า33 (beam-endpoint rule).

2026-07-24 (2nd pass, verified against the source images pixel-by-pixel): B' corrected 12.5 -> 12.2; 1'' and 1''' sourced to A-04's 1.50+0.50+2.00 sub-split of the grid1-grid2 bay; A' kept but its 'carport with real beams' story retracted (it is the ทางเดิน/ST.1 entrance step, and no beam lands on it). Two dummy lines now deliberately carry no beam: 1''(1.50) and A'(15.45) -- both are printed, dimensioned building lines that happen to be wall/slab edges rather than beam lines.
2026-07-24: file restructured to match houses 01-04 (x_lines/y_lines moved under a 'grid' wrapper, 'view_title' renamed to 'note') so every house's grid-master training target has the same shape.
